items.overview: Down-and-out university student Chen Yuan, devotedly pursues Goddess Lin Shutong for three years, gets kicked in the face. In his grief, he accidentally activates the “Licking Dog System” with a memory of 90 trillion Licking Dog Money, solely for licking women. The more you spend, the more you get back, and you can also obtain various attribute bonuses, transforming into a little superhero. It's called the Licking Dog System, but do I really want to be a licking dog? As long as I lick enough, I'll be the king. As long as I prove my love with enough money, I can turn the goddess into my licking dog! At this moment, Chen Yuan, who has undergone a great awakening, embarks on his life as a rich and licking dog.

items.title: Ring ni Kakero
aliases: Put It All in the Ring
items.overview:
Friendship. Effort. Victory!

The story centers around the life of a young boxer named Ryuji Takane and his sister Kiku, who is his coach. Ryuji and his sister both inherited their father's talent for boxing with Ryuji inheriting his strength and techniques while Kiku picked up his talent for analysis and strategy. In the past, their father was a famous boxer. Ryuji and Kiku went away from home to train and become famous in order to help their lonely mother. On the way to stardom, they have to defeat the strongest challengers all over the world.

The work that solidified the themes of Weekly Shonen Jump. Those themes being Friendship, Effort, and Victory!

items.title: Futari Machiaruki
items.overview:
When Hinata, a female university student, starts living on her own after entering college, she finds herself in a city that’s perfectly livable but dull and boring. Thinking she’ll just spend the next four years of university here, she shrugs it off… until one day, she encounters Kage, a young man taking photos of seemingly ordinary spots around town.

Intrigued by Kage’s actions, Hinata decides to go on a city-walking adventure with him! As they stroll together, the ordinary city she once found boring begins to reveal unexpected charm… and wonders! If you walk through a seemingly mundane town with the right person, the world bursts with fascinating colors!

A city-walking romantic comedy featuring a socially savvy female university student and a young man aspiring to be a professional manga assistant!
